- **Why p3:** the action is correctly disabled; the user cannot learn why.
- **Direction:**

  - ⛔ An author-written reason beside the `disabled` predicate is a spec key in objectstack (`domain:spec`). It is not in this card
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell: DeclaredActionsBar renders a declared action disabled by its spec disabled predicate with no title, tooltip or aria-describedby | the platform path: the predicate is evaluated client-side (useCondition), so the bar knows the button is disabled by declaration and not by loading | every end user on a record page whose action is disabled by its predicate (showcase Task: Archive until done)`
Thread-read: 6043323597
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking. No `area:records` card is in flight on this file. This seat's objectui#11810 (`area:records`) holds `plugin-list` `ListView.tsx`, `components` `filter-builder.tsx`, and two other keys in the same ten locale packs. Both add keys to the packs, and whoever lands second merges `main`. No open objectui PR touches `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` (read 2026-10-07T22:33Z).

Why `Clause-②: yes` (triage wrote `no` before the string's home was read): `DeclaredActionsBar` takes its strings from `@object-ui/i18n` (`useObjectTranslation`), and no existing key says "not available for this record". The nearest, `notAvailableHere`, means "not on this page". So the generic reason is a new key in the published packs (`./locales` is in that package's `exports`): an additive widening. So:
- the changeset declares at least `minor`;
- the PR body carries `Clause-②: yes` at line start;
- a contract-review-tier record is owed before the PR is queued; the seat runs it.

If the dev finds an existing key that fits exactly, it reports that before the PR, and the seat amends this line back.

Claim amendment — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-07T23:42Z. It amends claim `6048244335` after the dev's report `6049038332`. The claim stands otherwise.

- **Correction, the seat's.** The claim's Responsibility line named `DeclaredActionsBar` as the code that draws the Task page's Archive. The dev measured that it does not.
  - On the showcase Task page (`showcase_task_detail`), the header's Archive is a `page:header` action drawn by `PageHeaderRenderer`'s `renderButton` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:2070` on `16cda0b`).
  - The section bar's Archive is `record:quick_actions`, drawn by `QuickActionButton` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx`).
  - `DeclaredActionsBar` renders only `sys_approval_request` actions. It has the same defect class, so the fix there stands.
- **File surface, added:** `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`renderButton`, and the header's overflow `DropdownMenuItem` in the same renderer), and a test beside it. `@object-ui/components` joins the changeset under the fixed group's `minor`.
- **The dev's open question, answered A.** The same local wrapper goes on the header's inline action and its overflow item, with no new export, prop, type member or key. The reason applies only to an authored action's declared `disabled` predicate. The host-injected Edit and Delete, whose `disabled` is a host-computed boolean, stay as they are. Then the draft PR opens with `Fixes #11811`.
- **Not this card:** the `action:button` / `action:icon` / `action:group` / `action:menu` renderers (`packages/components/src/renderers/action/*`) are filed as their own family card, objectui#11839, because whether one shared helper should be exported is that card's decision.
- **`Clause-②: yes`** stands (one new key, `actions.notAvailableForRecord`, in the ten packs). A contract-review record is owed on the PR's head.

ACCEPT — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-08T00:30Z. PR objectui#11841, head `e165c34`.

- **PR shape:** draft against `main`. First line `Fixes #11811`, no other closing keyword. Line 3 is `Clause-②: yes`. Assigned to `os-support-ai`. Commits carry only the model-free trailer pair. The body records that the claim's original Responsibility named `DeclaredActionsBar`, and that the Task page is drawn by `page:header` and `record:quick_actions` (the seat's correction, `6049093782`).
- **Scope:** 17 files, +751/−28, exactly the amended surface:
  - `components` `containers.tsx` (the header);
  - `plugin-detail` `record-quick-actions.tsx` (the section bar);
  - `app-shell` `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`;
  - one key, `actions.notAvailableForRecord`, in the ten packs;
  - three new pin files;
  - the changeset.

  Nothing under `packages/components/src/ui/`. No new spec key, no export, prop or type member. No `@objectstack/*` import added, so no spec floor moves. No governed path.
- **Diff read (the seat's own):** each surface wraps a control disabled by its declared predicate in a focusable span, the tooltip trigger. An `sr-only` description is pointed at by `aria-describedby` from both the button and the span. A loading, running or host-computed disabled control is unchanged.
  - On the header, the action-list memo returns the authored keys, so the host-injected Edit and Delete (a host boolean) and the inline-edit lock keep no reason.
  - The header's ⋯ overflow item shows the reason as a visible second line, which is its `aria-describedby`, while `aria-labelledby` keeps the name. That is a measured deviation: the installed Radix menu skips a disabled item in arrow focus and traps Tab, so a tooltip there could not be reached from the keyboard. Accepted.
- **Ruling honoured** (triage `6043323597`): a tooltip and an accessible description on a disabled declared action, saying "Not available for this record". No author-written reason (that is a spec key, not this card).
- **Contract review:** `6049627052`, **PASS** on `e165c34` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, an isolated reviewer, `Local-runs: none`). It also checked the manifests against the new imports: `useSafeTranslate` from `@object-ui/i18n` and the Tooltip family from `@object-ui/components`, both existing dependencies.
- **Changeset sentences checked against the head:**
  - "now says why", and the `aria-describedby` sentence;
  - the header bullet, including the overflow item's second line and why;
  - the section-bar and `DeclaredActionsBar` bullets;
  - the one key.

  `i18n` and `components` `minor`, `app-shell` and `plugin-detail` `patch`: one fixed group at `minor`.
- **Reverse verification (dev reports `6049038332`, `6049354721`):**
  - Wrapper ablation on the section bar and `DeclaredActionsBar` turned 10 red and 4 green (the controls). On the header it turned 4 red (description, hover, focus, zh) and 3 green (the overflow item and both controls). Each was restored with the blob equal to HEAD.
  - A Chromium probe confirmed that a `pointer-events-none` disabled button never receives hover, which is why a `title` cannot work.
  - `components` plus 36 header-related files passed 4640; `plugin-detail` / `i18n` plus 27 files passed 4252.
- **Gates:** CI on `e165c34` (`head_sha` equals the PR head): 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, its shard template, `dependabot`), 0 failure. `Lint` and `Type Check` are success. Mergeable state `clean`, after objectui#11836 landed in the same ten packs.

Findings:
- The `action:*` renderers draw a predicate-disabled control with no reason → filed #11839 (by the seat, from report finding 1)
- `InlineEditSaveBar`'s `title` on its disabled Save cannot show, because of `pointer-events-none`. The approval-lock band already shows that reason on screen, so there is no measured user-facing gap. The review escalated it, and the seat rules it not filed → `Acceptance notes`
- A predicate that faults (fail-soft) also greys the action out and now shows the generic reason. That is consistent, though the wording slightly over-claims for a broken predicate → `Acceptance notes`

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the queue, now.
